title.narrative: Delivery of integrated Health, MHPSS and GBV support for vulnerable communities in rural Khersonska, Mykolaivska, and Odeska oblasts

description.narrative: ltpgtNearly three years into the escalation of the war in Ukraine, the humanitarian crisis remains acute. Ongoing hostilities continue to cause immense suffering, widespread destruction, and the displacement of millions, leaving the most vulnerable exposed to protection risks. Frontline communities are disproportionately affected, facing infrastructure damage, disrupted essential services, and weakened health systems. ltbrgtIn response, ltbgtthe International Rescue Committee (IRC)lt/bgt, in partnership with ltbgtFortitude UAlt/bgt and local health facilities, proposes the delivery of integrated, lifesaving health and protection services in frontline, rural, and hard-to-reach areas of ltbgtMykolaivskalt/bgt (Bashtanskyi, Pervomaiskyi, Mykolaivskyi rayons), ltbgtKhersonskalt/bgt (Khersonskyi, Beryslavskyi), and ltbgtOdeskalt/bgt (Izmailskyi, Berezivskyi) oblasts. The intervention aligns with the 2nd Thematic Priority: providing essential services in areas affected by active hostilities. ltbrgtThe project will serve ltbgt27,422lt/bgt conflict-affected individuals—especially women, children, older persons, and people with disabilities—through: ltbrgtlt/pgtltulgtltligtPrimary and outpatient specialized healthcare lt/ligtltligtMental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS) lt/ligtltligtGender-based violence (GBV) prevention and response lt/ligtltligtCapacity building for health workers and partners lt/ligtltligtCommunity engagement and outreach lt/ligtlt/ulgtltpgtIRC will lead on MHPSS and GBV in all locations, while Fortitude UA will provide health services in Beryslavskyi (Khersonska) and Bashtanskyi and Mykolaivskyi (Mykolaivska). Services will be tailored to the needs of IDPs, returnees, and other vulnerable groups to ensure timely, equitable, and dignified humanitarian support. ltbrgtIn coordination with local authorities, health facilities, and hromada representatives, IRC and Fortitude UA will ensure safe implementation and community trust. The project builds on IRC’s access in all sites and will expand activities in Odeska oblast in response to emerging needs, in coordination with the Health Cluster and relevant actors. ltbrgtThe response includes strong referral systems between IRC and Fortitude UA, allowing for comprehensive, cross-sectoral support. Security assessments, PPE, and safety protocols ensure operational safety. The project also includes capacity building and training for local stakeholders to promote sustained service access. ltbrgtIRC and Fortitude UA actively engage in the Health Cluster, technical task forces, and working groups. In 2025, IRC was re-elected to the Health Cluster’s Strategic Advisory Group (SAG), reaffirming its leadership and commitment to coordination, gap-filling, and avoiding duplication. ltbrgtWomen’s Protection and Empowerment (WPE) activities are integrated into IRC’s Mobile Health Teams, including: ltbrgtlt/pgtltulgtltligtGBV awareness sessions for communities and health staff lt/ligtltligtReferrals for GBV case management with emergency support lt/ligtltligtDistribution of dignity kits, including adolescent-focused kits lt/ligtltligtGBV prevention and SRH sessions for adolescent girls and women caregivers lt/ligtltligtDevelopment of tailored IEC materials lt/ligtlt/ulgtltpgtThese interventions promote safe, confidential, survivor-centered care and increase GBV awareness among medical staff, students, and patients. The project ensures inclusive service delivery, integrating protection mainstreaming, age and disability inclusion, and accountability to affected populations (AAP). PSEA measures are embedded throughout. ltbrgtMonitoring and reporting will be disaggregated by age, gender, and disability, ensuring inclusive analysis and adaptive programming. ltbrgtIRC’s robust systems in procurement, finance, HR, and compliance—guided by global SOPs—will ensure efficient, transparent implementation and maximum impact for communities affected by the conflict. ltbrgtlt/pgt
